name: Design first
description: Model the system before building it. While the stage is design, agents cannot start or finish build work.

stages.name: Design
stages.preamble: Project stage: design. The model is still being shaped, so do not start build work on any node. Spend effort on structure, specs, implementation globs and contracts.

stages.name: Build
stages.preamble: Project stage: build. The design is agreed. Implement your node against its spec and contract, and propose model changes rather than editing around them.
